parent_sections.title: Open-Source Software and Code Usage Policy
parent_sections.heading: # **Open-Source Software and Code Usage Policy**

provenance.evidence_quote:
Violation may result in rejected pull requests, blocked releases, package quarantine, revocation of repository or CI

privileges, mandatory remediation, disciplinary action up to and including termination, contractual remedies for
suppliers, and legal escalation where licensing or IP obligations are breached. Security may require immediate

removal of a component without waiting for a normal release window when active exploitation or malicious

supply-chain activity is suspected.

Where a violation creates active risk, protective action may occur before disciplinary or contractual review is complete.

Enforcement decisions will consider intent, recurrence, severity, impact, legal duties, and whether the individual

promptly reported the issue and cooperated with remediation.
